summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by NatWest Group plc, a UK-based bank, reporting its interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing primarily contains standard financial disclosures including segment reporting, litigation updates (including VAT assessments, antitrust, and FX-related matters), and details of ongoing share buyback programmes. No special-situation transaction such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is announced. The filing represents normal periodic reporting obligations for a foreign private issuer under US securities laws and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
